log_debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging (for troubleshooting only).

log_file.description: Path to the carbon-relay daemon log file.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file used to track the daemon process.

max_open_files.description: Maximum number of open file descriptors (adjust for high-traffic deployments).

log_buffer_size.description: Size (in bytes) of the log buffer before forced flush.

log_flush_interval.description: Seconds between forced log flushes (if buffer not full).

tcp.description: TCP listener settings (required for Graphite line protocol).

bind_address.description: IP to bind the TCP listener (use `0.0.0.0` for all interfaces).

max_metric_length.description: Maximum allowed length (bytes) for a single metric line.

enabled.description: Enable UDP listener (not recommended for production due to reliability).

bind_address.description: IP to bind the UDP listener.

max_metric_length.description: Maximum allowed length (bytes) for a single UDP metric packet.

relay_rules.description: Ordered list of routing rules to forward metrics to destination clusters.

name.description: Rule name (must be unique; used for identification).

match.description: Regex pattern to match metric names (case-sensitive by default).

destinations.description: List of destination cluster names, or `*` to forward to all enabled clusters.

replicate.description: Set to `true` to replicate all matched metrics to all destinations (for fan-out).

destination_clusters.description: List of destination clusters (Graphite backends) to forward metrics to.

name.description: Cluster name (used by relay rules in `destinations`).

port.description: Port used on all backend servers (typically 2003 for plaintext).

protocol.description: Protocol to use (`tcp` is strongly recommended).

replication_factor.description: Number of copies to send (requires consistent hashing).

connect_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for connection establishment before retrying.

consistent_hashing.description: Enable consistent hashing for even distribution across backends (required for replication >1).

hash_function.description: Hash algorithm for consistent hashing (use `murmur` for better performance with many servers).

cache.description: Local buffering settings to reduce backend load.

max_size.description: Maximum number of metrics held in cache before blocking writers.

write_strategy.description: Strategy for merging updates in the cache (see official docs for details).

max_updates_before_flush.description: Max buffered updates before forcing a flush to backends.

flush_interval.description: Seconds between periodic flushes (even if buffer not full).

flush_max_packs.description: Max metric packs to flush in one batch (prevents overwhelming backends).

aggregations.description: Optional metric aggregation rules (e.g., compute per-minute averages).

match.description: Regex pattern for metric names to aggregate.

function.description: Function to apply over the interval.

interval.description: Aggregation interval in seconds (must be a divisor of 3600 for nice Graphite aggregation).

prefix.description: Prefix to prepend to the aggregated metric name.

forward_rules.description: Legacy forward rules (deprecated in newer versions; prefer `relay_rules`).
